highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 stabilizes the Skia m151 engine update with managed color-conversion improvements.
highlights_body: The release improves WebAssembly exception handling, continues moving hot color operations into managed code, and refreshes HarfBuzzSharp.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome m151 and incorporates the related upstream bug fixes.
Builds WebAssembly native libraries with current exception-handling support and adds preview-runtime coverage.

bullets.lead: Color conversions moved to managed code
bullets.detail: Common SKColor and SKPMColor conversions avoid unnecessary native interop while preserving the existing API behavior.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: WebAssembly build cleanup, managed color conversion work, and HarfBuzzSharp updates

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m151 line and introduced the initial WebAssembly and color-conversion work.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 expanded managed conversion coverage and refreshed HarfBuzzSharp.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Release Candidate 1 consolidated the m151 fixes for final validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp and its generated bindings for the 4.151 release line.
